row: Vet Universe is a veterinary-led channel dedicated to explaining pet care in a simple, clear, and practical way. From common health problems and emergency warning signs to daily care tips, nutrition, and prevention — everything is explained by a veterinarian to help you keep your pets healthy and safe.
